newsitem.title: LEBANON: Audi up, BLC steady on Beirut market.
newsitem.headline: Audi up, BLC steady on Beirut market.

text.p: Shares of Banque Audi rose on Thursday on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), keeping up a strong performance since they began trading three days ago.
Audi rose to $15.75 from Wednesday's $15.625. A total of 37,477 shares changed hands inside and outside the bourse.

Of these, 20,377 shares were traded on the BSE floor compared with 50,000 a day earlier. Also, a block trade of 7,100 Audi shares changed hands on the floor at $15.75 while another block of 10,000 traded at $15.75 outside the bourse floor.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, which began trading on December 30, remained unchanged from Wednesday's $12.375 on turnover of 2,000 shares against Wednesday's 2,000.
BLC has risen steadily since it began trading at $11.25.
Solidere A shares slightly fell to $10.625 from $10.75 on Wednesday and B shares rose to $11.25 from $11.
Turnover on the BSE in all traded shares fell to 94,364 from Wednesday's 99,739 for a value of $1,436,212 against $1,323,358 a day earlier.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.54 percent to 922.36 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.01 percent to 81.75.
